summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 56 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Why the current tech backlash feels different
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CISA: WatchGuard RCE flaw now exploited in ransomware attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 55 articles published in the last 24 hours
